messages:
jared: Quick heads-up: planned TF apply for release v3.4.1 tonight 01:30 UTC. Scope: split public/private route-tables, tighten assume_role policy for service accounts, and move provider to 4.35.0. Need owners for networking + IAM rollback and a tested rollback script.
nina: I'll own networking (route-table split). Canary in eu-west-1 first, 2 instances.
lucy: I'll own IAM and rollback scripts. I have rollback snippets: `scripts/iam-revert.sh` and `scripts/iam-restore-policies.sh`.
sre-oncall: Please set deploybot backoff: pause if 5xx > 1% for 3m or p50 latency +15% for 4m. I'll monitor.
jared: opsbot 17 can you pin provider + create quiet window and attach release notes?
opsbot: Pinned terraform-provider-aws v4.35.0 in workspace infra-release-v3.4.1. Quiet window scheduled 01:1502:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal/releases/v3.4.1
deploybot: Preflight: terraform plan ran on branch release/v3.4.1. Findings: 1 provider mismatch in modules/network, 1 manual-approve resource: aws_iam_role.service-bridge (assume_role change).
nina: I'll refresh the module drift now and push a tiny fix for the route-table naming.
lucy: Eng-security: the assume_role tightening will change the trust document. Need security sign-off on the policy diff before apply.
eng-security: Reviewing policy diff in PR #4301. Will approve if key rotation plan is included.
release-manager: Reminder: add a short blurb to release notes about possible transient telemetry differences while route split propagates.
jared: Canary plan: wave1 eu-west-1 (2 nodes) 6m, manual verify; wave2 eu-central-1 6m. If wave fails, rollback that wave and stop.
sre-oncall: Add a smoke check to verify /health endpoints and metric export within 90s after apply.
opsbot: Rollback playbook created and attached. JIRA INFRA-5002 created for cutover-trace.
deploybot: Starting apply: workspace infra-release-v3.4.1 (wave1 eu-west-1) at 01:30:00 UTC
deploybot: Apply progress: 8 resources changed, 1 replaced.
nina: Wave1 smoke: initial request flow looks okay. Confirming metrics pipeline still receiving.
sre-oncall: Seeing spike in 502s for one service in eu-west-1 at +2.5% for 2m. Deploybot backoff not yet triggered.
lucy: Checking IAM logs - a service account in the mesh failed to assume new role due to missing principal in the tightened trust.
jared: Initiate immediate rollback for wave1. Lucy, please run rollback script now.
lucy: Running `./scripts/iam-restore-policies.sh --target=eu-west-1` now.
opsbot: INFRA-5002 updated: status=in-progress. Pausing further waves.
deploybot: Rolling back infrastructure changes for wave1.
deploybot: Rollback completed for wave1. Health and 502s returned to baseline.
sre-oncall: Confirmed metrics and traffic normalized. No escalation.
jared: Team, we caught an IAM trust edge case in canary, rollback worked as expected. We'll adjust the trust diff and re-run a smaller egress-less route change tomorrow at 03:00 UTC.
lucy: I'll update the PR with the explicit principal for the mesh and add an integration test.
eng-security: Approved the updated policy; will co-sign on re-run.
nina: I'll rework the route-table change to avoid simultaneous route propagation; plan for staged prefix adds.
release-manager: I'll update release notes to reflect canary rollback and link INFRA-5002.
jared: Final checklist before we close this thread: owners assigned, rollback scripts exercised, provider pinned, quiet window used, canary failed and rollback confirmed, follow-up scheduled. Thanks all. :white_check_mark: 
opsbot: Closing quiet window and attaching incident notes: https://internal/incidents/INFRA-5002/notes
release-manager: Adding note to release: "Canary detected IAM trust regression; change paused and rollback performed. Fix scheduled for 03:00 UTC next day."
